items.author: XCITE
items.text:
## OWG Launcher 1.16.2

### Fixed
- Mods no longer show "Steam updating" when only their Workshop page was edited.

items.author: XCITE
items.text:
## OWG Launcher 1.16.1

### Improved
- If Steam won't subscribe to a mod, the launcher now says so instead of showing "Queued" forever.
- Clear message when a server lists a mod without a Steam Workshop ID.

items.author: XCITE
items.text:
## OWG Launcher 1.16.0

### New

- **Stuck mod checklist** — if a mod download gets stuck when you click PLAY, the launcher walks you through the fixes in order: re-download the mod, restart Steam, reset Steam's DayZ mod list, and verify DayZ files. Each step you've tried gets a green ✓, and the launcher joins the server as soon as the download starts.

items.author: XCITE
items.text:
## OWG Launcher 1.15.4

### Improved
- The join splash closes when Steam has mods to download, so you can see the progress.
- If a mod download gets stuck, new buttons help fix it: Re-download, open Steam's Downloads page, or open the mod's Workshop page.

items.author: XCITE
items.text:
**--==OWG LAUNCHER UPDATE v1.15.3==--**

### Fixed
- The launcher no longer says DayZ crashed after a normal exit..

items.author: XCITE
items.text:
**--==OWG LAUNCHER UPDATE v1.15.0==--**

### New
- **Online now, by server** — pick a server from the drop-down to see who's on it and how long they've been playing. Shows 12 at a time; click "Show all" for the rest.
- **Your hived survivor** — when you're playing a standalone server, the hived server your character was last on gets a 🦉 YOUR HIVED SURVIVOR tag, and the Hived Servers heading tells you which one it is.

items.author: XCITE
items.text:
**--==OWG LAUNCHER UPDATE v1.14.3==--**

### New
- **Music while you wait** — the ♫ button plays the OWG music playlist in a small YouTube player. Click it again (or the ✕) to turn it off. Music keeps playing while mods download and stops when DayZ starts.
- **Join our Discord** — new speech-bubble button next to the ♫, settings and help icons.
- **Holiday themes** — the launcher dresses up for Halloween (bats), Christmas (snow), New Year's (fireworks and confetti) and the 4th of July (fireworks and stars). Turn them off in Settings → Look → Holiday decorations.
- **Maintenance mode** — when admins are working on a server, its button shows MAINTENANCE with a note about when it'll be back.

### Improved
- Clicking **Refresh** now picks up server list changes right away.
- Holiday animations now play even when Windows animation effects are turned off.
- Help file updated with the new features.

items.author: XCITE
items.text:
**--==OWG LAUNCHER UPDATE v1.12.2==--**

### Why can't I join?
- After DayZ closes, the launcher explains why you were kicked, disconnected or crashed, in plain English, with what to do next.
- Warns when your DayZ version doesn't match a server's, and tells you whether to update DayZ or wait for the admins.
- Waits for Steam to finish updating DayZ before joining, and shows the download progress.
- Warns when there isn't enough disk space for a server's mods.

### Server restarts
- Each server shows a countdown to its next restart ("Restart in 1h 12m").
- Joining within 10 minutes of a restart asks you first.
- Joining is blocked in the last minute before a restart.

### Other
- Help file updated with the new features.

items.author: XCITE
items.text:
**--==OWG LAUNCHER UPDATE v1.11.0==--**

- Gear icon at the bottom-right, just left of the ?. Hovering shows "Settings — sounds, mods & joining."

- The bottom bar now holds just Player name, the gear, the ? and the version.

- The Settings page is sorted into three sections:
**Joining: **Auto-join when mods finish, and Minimize when DayZ starts.
**Mods:** Pre-download mods for every server, and Clean up mods (an Open button that launches the cleanup window).
**Sounds:** Alert sounds.

- Each setting has an ⓘ. Hovering over it shows a short explanation, like the pre-download one in the screenshot.

- Clean up mods has moved off the server list into Settings. The server list header now only has ↻ Refresh.

- Closing: the ✕, Esc, or clicking outside the page.

- Settings are unchanged: existing players keep their current choices.
